items.title: Frank Goudie Interview
items.q: I had that two years, started working in Mexico with those Matthew Brothers

ctx.x: Oh, yeah. All this time, I mean, you were picking up on as much music as you could. I mean, uh... Yes.

Well, you see, I had that two years, started working in Mexico with those Matthew Brothers, which was good musicians. They taught me how to transpose, I mean, how to read and how to transpose music. You see, because we couldn't get the orchestration over there in Mexico. We couldn't get, receive those piano parts. And then they taught me how to read piano parts without writing, write a trumpet part.
